subject: Implement basic Pydantic AI agent with web_search and fetch_url tools
description:
Wire up the Pydantic AI agent in `capo/agent.py` (using the SOUL+ops loader output) and register the basic non-coding tools in `capo/tools/basic.py`: `web_search`, `fetch_url`.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] Pydantic AI `Agent` is constructed once per process with `instructions=<composite>`, deps_type=`CapoDeps`, model from `config.models.default`.
- [ ] `web_search(query: str) -> list[SearchResult]` tool implemented and registered.
- [ ] `fetch_url(url: str) -> str` tool implemented and registered (with reasonable max body size).
- [ ] Agent supports `agent.run(text, message_history=..., deps=...)` returning a reply string.

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] `fetch_url` non-2xx response returns a structured error to the agent, not an exception.
- [ ] `web_search` empty query rejected with clear tool error.

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Tool exceptions logged but never crash the agent loop.

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: agent constructs successfully with composite instructions
• Unit: each tool has happy path + one error case test
• Unit: SOUL is absent from any rendered tool/system prompt other than agent instructions (anchoring §5.1)

Source: internal/specs/capo-SPEC.md Sections 5.1, 9.1
